title: Dashy Configuration
description: JSON Schema for Dashy YAML configuration files. See https://dashy.to/docs/configuring/ for full documentation.

pageInfo.description: Basic meta data like title, description, nav bar links, footer text

title.description: Your dashboard title, displayed in the header and browser tab

description.description: Description of your dashboard, also displayed as a subtitle

logo.description: The path to an image to display in the header (to the right of the title). Can be local (relative to ./public) or remote URL

footerText.description: Text to display in the footer. This can include HTML and inline CSS

navLinks.description: Optional list of a maximum of 6 links to display in the navigation bar

title.description: The text to display on the link button

path.description: The URL to navigate to when clicked. Can be relative (e.g. /about) or absolute

appConfig.description: Settings related to how the app functions, including API keys and global styles

language.description: The 2 (or 4-digit) ISO 639-1 code for your language (e.g. en or en-GB)

defaultOpeningMethod.description: The default opening method for items if no target is specified

statusCheck.description: When true, Dashy will ping each service and display status as a dot next to each item

statusCheckInterval.description: The number of seconds between status checks. Set to 0 to check only on initial page load

theme.description: The default theme for first load (can be changed later from the UI)

layout.description: Layout for homepage, specifying direction of how sections are positioned

iconSize.description: The size of link items / icons

colCount.description: The number of columns of sections displayed on the homepage

backgroundImg.description: Path to an optional full-screen app background image (remote or local path)

faviconApi.description: Which service to use to resolve favicons. Set to 'local' to do this locally without an API

enableFontAwesome.description: If true, Font Awesome icons will be loaded. If false they will not be loaded

enableMaterialDesignIcons.description: If true, Material Design Icons will be loaded. If false they will not be loaded

fontAwesomeKey.description: Font Awesome kit key for using premium icons (10-digit alphanumeric string)

defaultIcon.description: An icon to be applied to any items which don't already have an icon set

customCss.description: Raw CSS that will be applied to the page. Please minify it first

externalStyleSheet.description: URL to an external stylesheet or array of URLs to apply as themes

cssThemes.description: An array of custom theme names which can be used in the theme switcher dropdown

customColors.description: Apply custom color palette to any given theme. Use theme name (lowercase) as key

enableMultiTasking.description: Keep apps open in background when in workspace view (may impact performance)

workspaceLandingUrl.description: URL to launch when workspace view is opened, before another service has been launched

preventWriteToDisk.description: If true, users will be prevented from saving config changes to disk through the UI

preventLocalSave.description: If true, users will be prevented from applying config changes to local storage

disableConfiguration.description: If true, no users will be able to view or edit the config through the UI

disableConfigurationForNonAdmin.description: If true, only admin users will be able to view or edit config through the UI

widgetsAlwaysUseProxy.description: If true, requests made by widgets will always be proxied

showSplashScreen.description: If true, a loading screen will be shown

enableErrorReporting.description: Enable reporting of unexpected errors and crashes using Sentry

sentryDsn.description: Sentry DSN for monitoring errors (only used if enableErrorReporting is true)

disableSmartSort.description: Disable most-used and last-used sort functions

disableUpdateChecks.description: If true, Dashy will not check for updates

enableServiceWorker.description: Service workers cache web apps to improve load times and offer offline functionality

disableContextMenu.description: If true, the custom right-click context menu will be disabled

webSearch.description: Configuration options for the web search feature

disableWebSearch.description: Web search is enabled by default, set to true to disable

searchEngine.description: Set the key name for your search engine

customSearchEngine.description: URL of custom search engine (required when searchEngine is 'custom')

openingMethod.description: Preferred opening method for search results

searchBangs.description: Custom search bangs for redirecting queries to specific apps or search engines

hideComponents.description: List of key page components that can be hidden

hideHeading.description: If true, the page title and subtitle will not be visible

hideNav.description: If true, the navigation menu will not be visible

hideSearch.description: If true, the search bar will not be visible

hideSettings.description: If true, the settings menu will be initially collapsed

hideFooter.description: If true, the footer will not be visible

auth.description: All settings relating to user authentication

users.description: Array of user credentials for simple authentication

enableGuestAccess.description: When true, unauthenticated users can access with read-only access

enableKeycloak.description: If true, authentication using Keycloak will be enabled

serverUrl.description: The URL where your Keycloak server is running

realm.description: The name of the realm (must already be created)

clientId.description: The Client ID of the client you created for use with Dashy

legacySupport.description: If using Keycloak 17 or older, set this to true

enableHeaderAuth.description: If true, authentication using HeaderAuth will be enabled

userHeader.description: The header name which contains username (case insensitive)

proxyWhitelist.description: Array of upstream proxy servers to expect authenticated requests from

enableOidc.description: If true, authentication using OIDC will be enabled

clientId.description: The client id registered in the OIDC server

endpoint.description: The URL of the OIDC server

adminRole.description: The role that will be considered as admin

adminGroup.description: The group that will be considered as admin

scope.description: The scope(s) to request from the OIDC provider

sections.description: An array of sections, each containing items or widgets

icon.description: An icon to be displayed next to the section title

items.description: Array of items to display within the section

title.description: The text to display / title of the item

description.description: Additional info shown in tooltip or on large tiles

url.description: The URL / location to navigate to when clicked

icon.description: Icon for the item (font-awesome, favicon, remote URL, or local path)

target.description: The opening method when the item is clicked

hotkey.description: Numeric hotkey (0-9) to launch this application

tags.description: List of tags for improved search

statusCheck.description: Enable/disable status check for this item (overrides global setting)

statusCheckUrl.description: Alternative URL for status checking if different from main URL

statusCheckHeaders.description: Custom headers for status check requests

statusCheckAllowInsecure.description: Allow status checks to non-HTTPS services

statusCheckAcceptCodes.description: Alternative success code(s) for status check (e.g. '403')

statusCheckMaxRedirects.description: Maximum number of redirects to follow for status checks

color.description: Custom color for text and icon (hex code or HTML color)

backgroundColor.description: Custom background color for the item (hex code or HTML color)

provider.description: The name of the provider for a given service

rel.description: The value of the rel attribute for the link

widgets.description: Array of widgets to display within the section

options.description: Widget-specific configuration options (varies by widget type)

updateInterval.description: Update frequency in seconds for continuous updates

useProxy.description: Route requests through CORS proxy for services that aren't CORS-enabled

ignoreErrors.description: Prevent error messages from being displayed if requests fail

label.description: Custom label for the widget (useful for identification)

pages.description: Array of additional config files for multi-page dashboards

name.description: A unique name for that page

path.description: Path (local or remote) to the config file. For files in /user-data, just specify filename

keycloakUserControl.description: Keycloak user visibility control based on groups and roles

itemDisplayData.description: Meta-data to override display settings for a given item

hideForUsers.description: Item will be hidden for users in this list

showForUsers.description: Item will be visible only for users in this list

hideForGuests.description: Item will be hidden for guests (unauthenticated users)

hideForKeycloakUsers.description: Item will be hidden for Keycloak users matching these groups/roles

showForKeycloakUsers.description: Item will be visible only for Keycloak users matching these groups/roles

sectionDisplayData.description: Meta-data to override display settings for a given section

sortBy.description: The sort order for items within the section

collapsed.description: If true, section will be collapsed initially

cutToHeight.description: Match section height with content height instead of filling available space

rows.description: Height of the section (number of rows to span vertically)

cols.description: Width of the section (number of columns to span horizontally)

itemSize.description: Specify the size for items within this section

color.description: A custom accent color for the section (hex code or HTML color)

customStyles.description: Custom CSS properties to apply to this section

sectionLayout.description: CSS layout type for positioning items (auto uses flex, grid uses CSS grid)

itemCountX.description: Number of items per row (only applies when sectionLayout is 'grid')

itemCountY.description: Number of items per column (only applies when sectionLayout is 'grid')

hideForUsers.description: Section will be hidden for users in this list

showForUsers.description: Section will be visible only for users in this list

hideForGuests.description: Section will be hidden for guests (unauthenticated users)

hideForKeycloakUsers.description: Section will be hidden for Keycloak users matching these groups/roles

showForKeycloakUsers.description: Section will be visible only for Keycloak users matching these groups/roles
